ideas.pitch: An AI-powered NGINX log analysis dashboard designed to detect and visualize real-time cyber threats and unauthorized traffic anomalies.
ideas.title: AegisLog: Real-Time AI NGINX Security Anomaly Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages direct inspiration from a past hackathon winner (danphobic) focusing on high-value security intelligence, which appeals strongly to judges looking for practical defense tooling.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight developer tool that inspects machine learning datasets and models for hidden demographic biases, providing automated mitigation techniques.
ideas.title: FairML-Guard: Automated Bias Detection and Mitigation for Tabular Data
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the rising regulatory and ethical concerns surrounding AI model fairness, following the architecture of a proven solo-built hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven GIS platform that compares multi-temporal satellite imagery to flag unauthorized industrial land use and environmental policy violations.
ideas.title: GeoCompliant: Satellite Monitoring for Industrial Land Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emulates an award-winning satellite analytics runner-up project, providing judges with a high-impact dashboard tackling real-world environmental and industrial compliance challenges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight edge-AI vision system that detects missing PPE (helmets, vests) in live camera feeds to prevent workplace accidents.
ideas.title: SafeZone-Edge: Industrial Safety Violation Detection System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly models a multi-time hackathon-winning architecture combining computer vision and edge deployments, demonstrating high real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video platform that transcribes, indexes, and enables semantic natural-language search over raw unstructured organizational video logs.
ideas.title: VideoLibrAI: Multimodal Video Intelligence and Search Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a first-prize winning design by transforming messy unstructured video data into fully interactive, searchable knowledge assets.
